stage_note: No stage is shown: a stage needs a source that approves this parcel itself, and the approvals on this timeline are for the project as a whole.
summary: Planned mixed-use block on the Potrero Power Station masterplan with a stepped height envelope up to 180 ft, one of three blocks (with 5 and 13) eligible to host the project's single permitted district parking garage; no design review approval or construction start found. The amended and restated development agreement, which includes Phasing Plan amendments, passed the Board of Supervisors on first reading on Sept 29, 2026 and Legistar lists it enacted on Oct 13, 2026 (Mayor 'APPROVED'); its effect on Block 1's timing has not been read.

milestones.text: Completion expected: Block 1 is in Phase 2 of the October 2020 re-phased program; SocketSite's block-by-block schedule for that program shows vertical development on Block 1 from 2029 to 2031; a 2020 forecast that the 2026 Phasing Plan amendments (see below) may have superseded
milestones.basis_note: Phase 2 in the October 7, 2020 Phase 1 and Phasing Plan Amendment approval; SocketSite's (Oct 9, 2020) 'Re-Phase Program, Detailed Construction Schedule' table gives Block 1 vertical development 2029-2031. A 2020 forecast, not a parcel-specific commitment: the same table's earlier dates (Block 15 vertical 2023-2026) have not held. Soft: BOS File 260724, an Amended and Restated Development Agreement whose title includes 'amendments to its Housing Plan, Transportation Plan, and Phasing Plan', passed the Board of Supervisors on first reading on 9/29/2026 (Legistar now lists 'Status: Passed', 'Final action: 10/13/2026' and 'Enactment #: 208-26'); the Sept 28, 2026 draft of that agreement (an attachment to the file; its Exhibit M-1 Phasing Plan) assigns improvements to Phases 1-3 and gives no calendar year for Block 1 development, and its phasing diagrams were not read for Block 1, so this forecast may be superseded.

milestones.text: Board of Supervisors approves the Potrero Power Station project and Development Agreement (Ordinance No. 62-20, Board File 200040), the entitlement covering the adopted Design for Development, whose Land Use Table (Table 3.1.1) lists Block 1 as a development block; the Development Agreement's own effective date is May 25, 2020, distinct from the D4D's own February 26, 2020 final-document date

facts.value: Residential, Institutional, Retail, Non-Retail Sales/Services (office) and Entertainment/Arts/Recreation uses permitted; Laboratory and Life Science uses Not Permitted (D4D final Table 3.1.1)

At most one District Parking Garage (max 90 ft, publicly accessible rooftop sports field) is permitted project-wide, only on Block 1, 5 or 13
Phase 2 per the October 7, 2020 Phase 1 approval; not in the 2024 compliance report's Phase 1 list (2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15)
Public Library option space moved here (Phase 2) from Block 15 (Phase 4) by the October 7, 2020 Phase 1 approval; not a committed branch

details.text: Height of Block 1: the heights are read from the colour-coded labels of the D4D's Figure 6.2.3; the figure's '115'MAX' marking is a plan-dimension line for the tower zone, not a height. The D4D's height-category text separately places Block 1 in a 'Midrise towers' category of 146-180 ft.

open_questions: No design review approval or construction-start date found for Block 1; it is not one of the six buildings named in the 2024 annual compliance report's Phase 1 list (Blocks 2, 7, 8, 11, 12, 15), and no later-phase design review approval was found either.

No source found claiming a specific planned use (e.g., grocery store) beyond the D4D's own generic 'Potential District Parking Garage Location, Potential Grocery Store Location' asterisk notation, which applies to Blocks 1, 5 and 13 collectively, not to Block 1 alone.

Block-specific schedule: the only one read is the 2020 forecast in SocketSite's table (Block 1 vertical development 2029-2031, Phase 2); no design review approval for Block 1 was found. BOS File 260724 (Amended and Restated Development Agreement, including amendments to its Phasing Plan; passed on first reading Sept 29, 2026; Legistar lists it enacted Oct 13, 2026) may change the phasing; the Sept 28, 2026 draft agreement attached to it (Exhibit M-1 Phasing Plan) gives no calendar year for Block 1, so no newer Block 1 date was found and the expected 2031 completion is a 2020 phase forecast only.
